Name: Ferngill Arcadium - New Arcade Games
Author: Deathbygin
Description:
[b]Like this mod? Endorse it! [url=https://ko-fi.com/deathbygin]Help me out by downloading the pinball playtest version for free on my Ko-fi! [/url][/b]
[b]Want your translation added to the next update? [url=https://github.com/deathbygin/Ferngill-Arcadium]Send a pull request on Github![/url]
[/b]
Heard the buzz? A mysterious old arcade just a short bus ride from Pelican Town has powered up... The Ferngill Arcadium is calling all high-score heroes and retro champions! Do you have what it takes to dominate the leaderboards? Featuring full controller support! Note: Multiplayer support is not currently implemented.

[b]FEATURES
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]A Brand-New Location:[/b] Discover the Ferngill Arcadium, a unique destination accessible from the Bus Stop.
[*][b]Five Custom Arcade Games:[/b] Master five brand new, fully-functional, vanilla-styled arcade machines! Each with its own unique challenge.
[*][b]Ticket & Prize System:[/b] Your skills pay off! Earn Arcadium Tickets from your high scores and trade them in for exclusive prizes.
[*][b]Bring the Arcade Home:[/b] Save up your tickets to win your very own arcade machines, which you can place and play on your farm
[/list][b]
◆ MASTER THE ARCADE ◆
[/b]Get your hands on five incredible, custom-made games with catchy retro soundtracks. Keep your eyes peeled for new games getting added with every update. Open the spoiler for the full lineup!

[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]JUNIMO PONG:[/b] A chaotic, power-up-fueled take on the timeless classic inspired by Pong.
[*][b]LABYRINTH:[/b] Guide Krobus through a maze, gobbling dots and avoiding pesky bats in this [i]Pac-Man[/i]-inspired adventure.
[*][b]CROP CRUSHER:[/b] Smash your way through levels of crops in this satisfying [i]Brick Breaker[/i]-style game.
[*][b]SLIMEFALL:[/b] Plunge into the depths as a slime, dodging enemies and collecting coins in this fast-paced vertical challenge inspired by Downwell.
[*][b]ZUZU CITY DRIFT:[/b] Weave through traffic and dodge bombs in a high-speed, [i]Outrun[/i]-inspired racer!
[/list][i](Note: The vanilla "Journey of the Prairie King" and "Junimo Kart" machines are also here for convenience but do not award Arcadium Tickets.)[/i][/spoiler]
[b]
◆ EARN TICKETS, WIN PRIZES! ◆[/b]
It's not just about glory! Every play on our custom machines earns you [b]Arcadium Tickets[/b]. Check your balance at the ticket machine, then head to the prize counter to trade them for awesome rewards. Playable furniture versions of each arcade machine can be redeemed. Can you collect them all and build the ultimate home arcade?

Check out my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37103]Ferngill Forest[/url]!
